blocks.content: The first host Maven run failed because PostgreSQL was not running and the Byte Buddy agent was not supplied. The candidate result is the repeated run with Compose PostgreSQL running and the explicit Byte Buddy agent. This separates an environment failure from the product result.

items: While the backend is running, polling adds the interval, one second by default, plus database operation time.
Backend downtime delays automatic cancellation and notification until the backend restarts.

Creation exactly three hours ahead is still accepted, while expiry and approval treat the same boundary as closed; the product must decide whether to unify the cutoff or formally accept the current state.
No dedicated multi-scheduler concurrency test or job-lag monitoring is evidenced; add them if required by the deployment model.
